purpose: Public keys for verifying ThoughtProof Sentinel M1 signed canonical exports (thoughtproof.sentinel.export.v1). This is a ThoughtProof key document (OKP members + TP status extensions) — not a pure JWKS. Receivers pin this URL and kid set out-of-band; the document alone is not a trust root.

keys.usage: Fixture / paired-vector signatures only. Private seed lives in scripts/gen-m1-export-vectors.mjs. NEVER used to sign production exports. Verifiers must reject this kid unless explicitly allowing vector-only keys.
Production M1 export signatures. Private key ONLY via env SENTINEL_EXPORT_PRIVATE_KEY (never in repo). Not EAS attester. Not X-Sentinel-Key.

alg_note: JWK alg is JOSE EdDSA (RFC 8037). Export-envelope alg is Ed25519 (primitive name on the signed fields). Same curve; do NOT string-compare the two fields against each other.

export.canonicalDigest: 0x || sha256(UTF-8(transported canonical JCS string)) — do not re-JCS an object
export.signature: Ed25519 detached over signedInput; wire encoding 0x + lowercase hex (64 bytes)

rotation: Publish new kid with status=active before first production use.
Never delete old keys — set notAfter and status=retired (or leave vector-only).
Key validity window (notBefore/notAfter) is evaluated against the export's signedAt, not the verifier clock — so rotated keys still verify historical artifacts.
validUntil on the export envelope is freshness for the verifier clock.
status=retired blocks new production trust (signing); historical verification still uses the signedAt window.
Receivers pin URL + kid set out-of-band.
vector-only keys must never become active; active keys must never have a private seed in the repo.
notes: status / notBefore / notAfter are ThoughtProof extensions on OKP key objects — allowed extras; this file is schema thoughtproof.keys.v1, not RFC 7517 JWKS.
Prod notBefore = first production publish day; vector notBefore may differ (fixture signedAt).
EAS attester and API keys are different trust roots and must not be substituted for this export key.
